title: SurgTransfer: Multi-Step Latent Action Modeling for Action Transfer in Surgical World Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.05443v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Surgical world models have the potential to provide intra-operative guidance, accelerate risk-free training and facilitate transfer of expert surgical maneuvers. However, the use of world models for transferring surgical expertise has been largely unexplored. Moreover, recent approaches in this domain have mainly relied on ground truth kinematics actions or expert annotations for specific tasks, limiting their applicability beyond the narrow range of tasks with ground-truth annotations. In contrast, existing works in the natural domain have shown promising results in learning latent actions solely from unlabeled videos and transferring the learned actions across contexts. translated_title: SurgTransfer：面向手术世界模型中动作迁移的多步潜在动作建模
translated_abstract: 手术世界模型有潜力提供术中指导、加速无风险训练，并促进专家手术操作的迁移。然而，利用世界模型来迁移手术专长在很大程度上尚未被探索。此外，该领域近期的方法主要依赖于特定任务的真实运动学动作或专家标注，这限制了其在缺乏真实标注的狭窄任务范围之外的应用。相比之下，自然图像领域的现有工作在仅从无标注视频中学习潜在动作并跨上下文迁移所学动作方面已展现出令人鼓舞的成果。我们观察到，这一范式对于手术领域而言是短视的，无法捕捉手术过程的层次化与目标导向结构。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的多步动作学习框架，用于学习上下文不变的潜在动作，从而（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 本文提出SurgTransfer框架，通过多步潜在动作建模从无标注手术视频中学习上下文不变的潜在动作，从而在无需真实运动学数据或专家标注的情况下实现手术世界模型中的专家动作迁移。
en_tdlr: SurgTransfer introduces a novel multi-step latent action learning framework that captures the hierarchical, goal-directed structure of surgical procedures and learns context-invariant latent actions from unlabeled videos, enabling expert action transfer in surgical world models without relying on ground-truth kinematics or expert annotations.
